expectations.text: Keeps the charter to one to two pages rather than a long strategy document.
expectations.evidence: The charter body runs roughly 1,600 words across twelve sections (Position, Driver, Goals, Audience, Pillar mix, Bets, Build vs buy table, Staffing, Refused, Open questions, Exec narrative, Review), which at normal density renders as roughly three-plus pages — over the one-to-two page target. Length is further inflated by a ~130-word preamble and a ~180-word 'Quality gate' self-audit appended after the document.
